complexityGate.logic: trigger = anyExplicitFlag OR (matchedSignals >= 1), where a matched signal means: A explicit flag; C satisfied = >=2 of its three sub-signals (C1 enumerated lines / C2 distinct action verbs / C3 action clauses); B >= 4 deliverable verbs; D a .mpd/plans plan file exists.

A_explicitFlag.detect: the trimming user text starts with 'team:' or contains '!team' (case-insensitive); the matching prefix is consumed and is not part of the goal text

B_deliverableVerbs.detect: >= 4 distinct matches of (align|migrate|refactor|audit|overhaul|port|rewrite|consolidate|对齐|重构|迁移|审计|移植|梳理|全量) in the user text

C_enumeratedSteps.detect: C fires when TWO OR MORE of its three independent sub-signals hold: C1 enumerated lines (^\s*(?:\d+[.)]|[-*|])\s) >= 3 — transcribed EXACTLY from the shipped ENUMERATED_LINE_PATTERN, whose `|` alternative covers markdown-table rows; C2 distinct action verbs (add|align|audit|build|change|check|consolidate|implement|migrate|overhaul|port|refactor|rewrite|verify|设计|实现|验证|改造|补充|对齐|重构|迁移|审计|移植|梳理|全量) >= 3; C3 a clause whose FIRST token, optionally after and|then|also, is an action verb — >= 3 such clauses (restated for precision: the shipped CLAUSE_ACTION_PATTERN anchors at ^\s* and admits an optional and|then|also, and its verb set is IDENTICAL to C2's).
C_enumeratedSteps.measure: count of C1, C2, C3; C is satisfied at >= 2 of 3
C_enumeratedSteps.revisionNote: SUPERSEDES the original literal wording ('C1 >= 3 OR C2 >= 3'). Measured contradiction: frozen complex prompt #1 ('Align the bundle with upstream: audit the orchestration surface, then implement the routing change.') has 2 enumerated lines and 2 action verbs, so the literal rule could never satisfy its own frozen complex side — while the frozen simple prompts must stay silent. The implemented form (C1/C2/C3 with a >= 2-of-3 majority) was accepted because it keeps BOTH frozen prompt sets falsifiable in practice: the two-sided case measures simple 3/3 silent and complex 3/3 triggering on a settled revision. Updating the prompts instead would have invalidated the evidence already produced against them. || R3 (2026-09-14): the verb lists above were HARMONIZED per the user's explicit choice and are transcribed VERBATIM from the shipped regexes; the trigger threshold was NOT changed.
